quests.name: Act 9 • Boss field notes
quests.description: Chapter-final encounters from Orochi to Carina. Carina 9.4.6 now has a shared overview plus separate pages for its three Signature Ability variants; path exploration and Epilogue versions are separate.

bosses.name: Carina — Mutant/Mystic Vulnerability
bosses.summary: Fight A of Act 9.4.6. The Signature Ability is Mutant-Mystic Vulnerability: Carina emulates Skill/Cosmic mechanics, while Mutant/Mystic attackers receive the intended class-pair advantages. The core route mechanic is Encroaching ISO Infection.

phases.name: Identify the variant
phases.text: Confirm the Signature Ability reads Mutant-Mystic Vulnerability and the fight is using Encroaching ISO Infection. Carina is drawing from Skill/Cosmic-style mechanics here; the vulnerability label names the attacker pair that receives the intended matchup advantages.

phases.name: Build Chrono Corruption with ISO Infection
phases.text: When ISO Infection is active, plan its expiry around a Special Attack or Striker. Preventing the Infection expiry damage this way advances Chrono Corruption. A Medium-opening Basic Attack sequence can affect the Infection timing, so watch the timer rather than spending a Special immediately after every combo.

phases.name: Phase 1 — respect Buff pressure
phases.text: The first half adds Buff-driven pressure and can make blocked hits less comfortable than they look. Use spacing and clean Special Attack dodges instead of treating Block as the default answer to every sequence.

phases.name: Phase 2 — manage Special Lock and Striker Lock
phases.text: Below 50%, the timing puzzle becomes stricter as Special Lock and Striker Lock can interfere with the tool you planned to use for ISO Infection. Preserve the available option and avoid entering the expiry window with both routes unavailable.

phases.name: Use Elder’s Resistance for sustain
phases.text: This variant can grant Elder’s Resistance through class-identity interactions such as shortening Carina’s Buff duration or using reduced-cost Special Attacks. Treat Elder’s Resistance as sustain support, not as a substitute for completing the Infection mechanic.

phases.name: Finish the individual encounter
phases.text: Continue converting ISO Infection cycles into Chrono Corruption until the encounter reaches its finishing state. The separate three-Carina special-path finale has additional story behavior and is covered on the overview page rather than being treated as this variant’s normal finish.

mistakes: Calling this the Skill/Cosmic Vulnerability fight because Carina is emulating Skill/Cosmic mechanics. The Signature Ability is Mutant-Mystic Vulnerability.
Throwing a Special Attack too early and then having no Special or Striker available when ISO Infection expires.
Relying on Parry Stun as the only opening once Tranquilize and the Phase 2 lock mechanics are active.
bosses.avoid: Prefer a Mutant or Mystic attacker whose normal rotation can leave a Special Attack or Striker available for ISO Infection expiry. Do not choose only by class: the player still has to execute the Infection timing.

bosses.name: Carina — Science/Tech Vulnerability
bosses.summary: Fight B of Act 9.4.6. The Signature Ability is Science-Tech Vulnerability: Carina is treated as Mutant/Mystic in addition to Superior, while Science/Tech attackers receive the intended class-pair advantages. The core mechanic is Corrupted ISO Blast.

phases.name: Identify the variant
phases.text: Confirm the Signature Ability reads Science-Tech Vulnerability and the node panel describes Corrupted ISO Blast. Carina is treated as Mutant/Mystic for attacker abilities in this version; Science/Tech is the vulnerability pair.

phases.name: Charge and reflect the Corrupted ISO Blast
phases.text: Well-Timed Blocks against eligible hits add Blast Energy, and Blast Energy also rises over time. When the projectile is launched, return it with a Well-Timed Block, Auto-Block, or a released Heavy Attack. A successful return gives Carina Chrono Corruption; Heavy reflections can accelerate that progress.

phases.name: Phase 1 — manage Prowess
phases.text: Critical Hits and certain expiring attacker Buffs can build Carina’s Prowess. At high enough Prowess her Special Attack 1 becomes Passively Unblockable, so watch the Prowess count instead of assuming SP1 can always be blocked.

phases.name: Phase 1 — use the Steadfast interaction when available
phases.text: Applying enough non-Damaging Debuffs can grant the attacker Steadfast. The fight also provides ways for Carina to lose personal Prowess when specific blocked or heavily reduced hits connect. Treat this as Prowess control, not as a reason to tank every attack.

phases.name: Phase 2 — expect the Blast to come back
phases.text: Below 50%, Carina can Block a reflected Corrupted ISO Blast and send it back. Stay ready to return the same projectile again instead of assuming one reflection completes the cycle.

phases.name: Phase 2 — track Root after Special Attacks
phases.text: Her Special Attacks start a delayed Root sequence in the second half. Leave enough room to manage the timer and avoid committing to a long action when the Root is about to become active.

mistakes: Calling this the Mutant/Mystic Vulnerability fight because Carina is treated as Mutant/Mystic. The Signature Ability is Science-Tech Vulnerability.
Reflecting the Corrupted ISO Blast once below 50% and then dropping your guard when Carina sends it back.
Ignoring Prowess and attempting to block an SP1 after it has become Passively Unblockable.
bosses.avoid: Science and Tech attackers receive the intended vulnerability benefits, but the decisive mechanic is still returning the Corrupted ISO Blast. Bring a Champion whose rotation leaves you comfortable reacting to repeated projectiles and the Phase 2 Root timer.

bosses.name: Carina — Skill/Cosmic Vulnerability
bosses.summary: Fight C of Act 9.4.6. The Signature Ability is Skill-Cosmic Vulnerability: Carina emulates Science/Tech mechanics, while Skill/Cosmic attackers receive the intended class-pair advantages. Progress comes from Corrupted ISO Traps.

phases.name: Identify the variant
phases.text: Confirm the Signature Ability reads Skill-Cosmic Vulnerability and the fight uses Corrupted ISO Traps. Carina is emulating Science/Tech-style mechanics here; Skill/Cosmic is the vulnerability pair.

phases.name: Create and respect Corrupted ISO Traps
phases.text: Carina can place Corrupted ISO Traps through her Heavy Attack and Special Attack 1. Crossing a Trap outside the protected timing damages the attacker, so remember where each Trap is instead of backing into it accidentally.

phases.name: Put Carina onto the Trap
phases.text: Use the fight’s required setup to store the Corruption opportunity, then use a Heavy Attack or Reversal to knock Carina onto a Corrupted ISO Trap. The Trap interaction is what converts the setup into Chrono Corruption.

phases.name: Phase 1 — manage Armor Up and Power pressure
phases.text: This version can build Armor Up-based pressure and gain substantial Power when its defensive setup is allowed to run. Utility that suppresses the relevant defensive effects can make the loop easier, but it does not replace the Trap objective.

phases.name: Phase 2 — wait out Inexorable before the knockback
phases.text: Below 50%, periodic Inexorable can prevent the knockback you need for the Trap. Do not spend the Heavy or Reversal while Inexorable is active; wait for the window, then move Carina onto the Trap.

phases.name: Phase 2 — account for Power Drain and Unsteady
phases.text: Special Attack 1 adds Power Drain and Unsteady pressure in the later half. Keep enough space and Power flexibility that the Trap plan still works after SP1 instead of forcing the interaction immediately.

mistakes: Calling this the Science/Tech Vulnerability fight because Carina is emulating Science/Tech mechanics. The Signature Ability is Skill-Cosmic Vulnerability.
Walking across a Corrupted ISO Trap outside the protected action window.
Trying to knock Carina onto a Trap while Inexorable is active and then assuming the Heavy/Reversal mechanic is broken.
bosses.avoid: Skill and Cosmic attackers receive the intended vulnerability benefits. Prefer a Champion that can control the fight without relying on constant knockback, because the second half periodically uses Inexorable and adds Power Drain/Unsteady pressure.

bossPatches.name: Carina (Chronoserpent) — Overview
bossPatches.summary: Shared Act 9.4.6 mechanics and navigation for the three Carina variants: Mutant/Mystic Vulnerability with Encroaching ISO Infection, Science/Tech Vulnerability with Corrupted ISO Blast, and Skill/Cosmic Vulnerability with Corrupted ISO Traps.

phases.name: Start here — read the Signature Ability
phases.text: Act 9.4.6 contains three different Carina versions. Identify the Signature Ability before choosing a guide: Mutant-Mystic Vulnerability, Science-Tech Vulnerability or Skill-Cosmic Vulnerability. The vulnerability pair names the attacker classes the fight is designed to favor; it is not the class pair Carina is emulating.

phases.name: Shared rule — build Chrono Corruption
phases.text: Every version has a different route mechanic that inflicts Chrono Corruption on Carina. Fight A uses Encroaching ISO Infection, Fight B uses Corrupted ISO Blast, and Fight C uses Corrupted ISO Traps. Use the dedicated variant page for the exact input sequence.

phases.name: Shared rule — build Elder’s Resistance
phases.text: Elder’s Resistance is a Cross-Fight attacker resource earned through variant-specific RPG interactions. It helps the attacker recover damage taken from Carina’s Special Attack pressure, but each variant awards it differently.

phases.name: Fight A
phases.text: Mutant-Mystic Vulnerability. Carina emulates Skill/Cosmic mechanics. Progress Chrono Corruption through Encroaching ISO Infection and plan around later Special Lock / Striker Lock timing.

phases.name: Fight B
phases.text: Science-Tech Vulnerability. Carina is treated as Mutant/Mystic. Progress Chrono Corruption by reflecting Corrupted ISO Blast and manage Prowess plus the second-half Root sequence.

phases.name: Fight C
phases.text: Skill-Cosmic Vulnerability. Carina emulates Science/Tech mechanics. Progress Chrono Corruption through Corrupted ISO Traps and respect Inexorable before attempting the required knockback.

phases.name: Special fourth path — three fights plus finale behavior
phases.text: Full exploration includes the three variants and a special path that presents them together. Community reports describe a story sequence near the end in which Carina can refill Health before the intended finish. Keep that finale separate from the normal finish conditions of any one variant.

mistakes: Using the emulated class pair as the page name and therefore opening the wrong variant guide.
Assuming the three mechanics are phases of one fight rather than three separate Carina versions.
Applying the special fourth-path finale behavior to an ordinary individual variant.
bossPatches.avoid: Choose the dedicated page by the exact Signature Ability shown in-game. Do not select only from a video title or shorthand such as 'Mystic Carina' because community sources sometimes name the emulated classes and sometimes name the vulnerability pair.
